schools.platform: Juilliard online application (apply.juilliard.edu)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 tuition only (same for international and domestic). Scorecard's latest published COA is $83,892.
audition_note: 많은 전공이 프리스크린 영상을 먼저 내고, 통과하면 뉴욕 캠퍼스에서 직접 오디션을 봐요(organ 등 일부 전공은 프리스크린 없음). 음악 전공은 영상 오디션을 받지 않고, 필요에 따라 여행비 지원금(need-based travel grant)이 조금 있어요.

Many majors require a prescreening recording first; those who pass audition in person on the New York City campus (some majors, e.g. organ, have no prescreen). Video auditions are not accepted for music, and limited need-based travel grants are available.
english_note: 영어가 모국어가 아니면 마감일까지 영어 점수를 내야 해요(TOEFL 새 점수 체계 4점, IELTS 6.0, SAT EBRW 610 등). TOEFL 99점 이하(또는 동급)는 ESL 디렉터 인터뷰가 있고, 최근 10년 중 7년 이상 영어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔으면 면제돼요.

Non-native speakers must submit English proof by the deadline (TOEFL new-scale 4, IELTS 6.0, SAT EBRW 610, etc.). Applicants at TOEFL 99 or below (or equivalent) must interview with the Director of ESL; exempt if 7 of the past 10 years were full-time English-medium schooling.
aid: 장학금은 재정 필요와 오디션·학업 실력을 함께 보고 줘요. 국제학생도 CSS Profile(코드 2340)을 내면 심사받고, 입학 심사는 need-blind이며 학생의 약 90%가 장학금을 받아요.

Juilliard scholarships combine financial need and merit (entrance audition + academics). International students apply via the CSS Profile (code 2340); admission is need-blind and about 90% of students receive scholarship support.
known: 뉴욕 링컨센터에 있는 무용·연극·음악 공연예술 학교로, 음악은 클래식·성악·재즈·작곡을 가르쳐요.
A performing-arts school at Lincoln Center in New York covering dance, drama and music, with music study in classical performance, voice, jazz and composition.

schools.platform: Curtis online application (connect.curtis.edu)
schools.cost_note: Tuition-free: every student gets a merit-based full-tuition scholarship (valued at $55,995 for undergraduates). Living costs and fees are not included.
audition_note: oboe를 뺀 모든 지원자가 원서와 함께 프리스크린 영상을 내고, 1월 중순쯤 오디션 초대 여부를 알려줘요. 오디션은 2~3월에 필라델피아 캠퍼스에서 직접 보고, 현장 진행이 어려울 때만 실시간 온라인 오디션으로 바꿔요.

All applicants except oboe submit a prescreening video with the application and hear about audition invitations around mid-January. Live auditions are held in person in Philadelphia in February-March; live virtual auditions are used only if in-person rounds are not possible.
english_note: 영어 점수는 합격 후 배치용으로 내요(TOEFL iBT 79-80/새 체계 4, IELTS 영역별 6.5-7.0, Cambridge 169). 점수가 모자라면 BM 대신 Diploma 과정에서 ESL 수업을 들어요.

English scores are submitted after acceptance for placement (TOEFL iBT 79-80 pre-2026 / 4 on new scale, IELTS 6.5-7.0 in each area, Cambridge 169). Students below the minimum are placed in the Diploma program with ESL classes instead of the BM.
aid: 모든 학생이 국적과 상관없이 전액 학비 장학금을 받고, 따로 신청할 필요가 없어요. 생활비는 CSS Profile로 need-based 지원을 신청할 수 있어요.
Every student, regardless of nationality, receives a full-tuition scholarship with no application required. Need-based aid for living expenses is available via the CSS Profile.
known: 학생 수 약 160명으로 일부러 작게 운영하는 학비 무료 음악원이고, 학생의 약 40%가 해외 출신이에요.
A tuition-free conservatory that deliberately keeps about 160 students; nearly 40 percent come from abroad.

schools.platform: NEC online application (apply.necmusic.edu)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition only; total billed costs incl. housing, fees and health insurance are $91,253.
audition_note: 대부분 전공은 12월 1일까지 원서와 함께 프리스크린 영상(작곡은 포트폴리오)을 내고, 통과하면 2월에 NEC에서 직접 오디션을 봐요. NEC에서 500마일 넘게 떨어져 사는 지원자는 일부 전공에 한해 최종 오디션을 영상으로 낼 수 있어요(2월 1일 마감).

Most programs require a prescreening video (portfolio for composition) with the Dec 1 application; those who advance audition live at NEC in February. Applicants living more than 500 miles from NEC may, for certain programs only, submit a recorded final audition (due Feb 1).
english_note: 영어가 모국어가 아니면 TOEFL iBT 61(새 체계 3.5, 영역별 3.5), IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 100 이상이 필요하고 1월 15일까지 내야 해요. 영어로 가르치는 미국 고교·대학 졸업 등은 면제될 수 있어요.

Non-native speakers need TOEFL iBT 61 (new scale 3.5, 3.5 per section), IELTS 6.0, or Duolingo 100, submitted by Jan 15 (a passing retake is accepted until Mar 1). Waivers exist, e.g. for graduates of U.S. high schools or English-language degree programs.
aid: 장학금은 재정 필요와 실력(주로 오디션)을 함께 보고 입학 시점에 줘요. CSS Profile은 받지 않고, 국제학생 장학금 자격은 공식 페이지에 따로 적혀 있지 않아 재정지원 사무실에 확인해야 해요.

Scholarships combine financial need and artistic merit (merit is mainly from the audition) and are offered at admission. NEC does not accept the CSS Profile, and its pages do not spell out international eligibility, so confirm with the Financial Aid Office.
known: 보스턴에 있는 음악원으로 클래식·성악·재즈·작곡·Contemporary Musical Arts를 가르치고, Harvard·Holy Cross와 5년제 복수학위 과정이 있어요.
A Boston conservatory teaching classical performance, voice, jazz, composition and Contemporary Musical Arts, with 5-year dual-degree programs with Harvard and Holy Cross.

schools.platform: MSM online application (apply.msmnyc.edu)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 tuition only; estimated billed cost on campus (tuition, fees, meal plan, double room) is $82,050, and the NY State projected COA is $88,512.
audition_note: 프리스크린이 있는 전공은 12월 1일까지 영상을 내고 12월 21일쯤 결과가 나와요. 학부(BM)는 모든 전공이 뉴욕 캠퍼스 대면 오디션 대신 영상·온라인 오디션을 볼 수 있어요(녹화 오디션 2월 1일 마감). Musical Theatre는 1월에 따로 오디션해요.

Majors with a prescreen upload videos by Dec 1; results come around Dec 21. For the BM, every major may audition virtually instead of in person in NYC (recorded auditions due Feb 1). Musical Theatre auditions are held separately in January.
english_note: 영어가 모국어가 아니면 Duolingo 점수만 받아요(TOEFL·IELTS 불가, 2026년 9월 1일 이후 응시, 12월 1일까지 제출). 최소 점수는 없지만 125+면 대체로 면제, 90-120이면 여름 영어 과정(SES) 배정 가능성이 있어요.

Non-native speakers must submit a Duolingo English Test score only (TOEFL/IELTS not accepted), taken after Sept 1, 2026 and reported by Dec 1, 2026. There is no minimum to apply; 125+ is likely exempt, while 90-120 may be assigned to Summer English Study.
aid: 오디션을 본 모든 지원자는 서류만 내면 교내 장학금 심사를 받아요. 국제학생은 CSS Profile과 MSM 재정지원 질문지를 2월 1일까지 내고, 장학금은 실력과 재정 필요를 함께 봐요.

Every applicant who auditions is considered for institutional scholarships if aid documents are complete. International students submit the CSS Profile and MSM's Financial Aid Questionnaire by Feb 1; awards are based on merit and demonstrated need.
known: 뉴욕에 있는 음악원으로 클래식·재즈·뮤지컬·현대음악 퍼포먼스를 가르치고, 50개국 넘는 나라에서 학생이 와요.
A New York conservatory offering classical, jazz, musical theatre and contemporary performance programs, with students from more than 50 countries.

schools.platform: SFCM online application (apply.sfcm.edu)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 tuition only; SFCM's estimated undergraduate COA is $87,185 (tuition, $1,750 fees, $21,400 living, books, personal, insurance).
audition_note: piano·voice·composition·violin·viola·cello·percussion·flute·oboe·RJAM·TAC 등은 프리스크린을 내고, brass·guitar 등은 바로 최종 오디션을 봐요. 기본은 2월 샌프란시스코 대면 오디션이지만 1월 15일까지 신청하면 영상(2월 15일 마감)이나 Zoom 오디션으로 대신할 수 있어요.

Areas such as piano, voice, composition, violin/viola/cello, percussion, flute, oboe, RJAM and TAC are prescreened; others (e.g. brass, guitar) go straight to a final audition. The standard is an in-person audition in San Francisco in February, but applicants can request a video (due Feb 15) or live Zoom audition by Jan 15.
english_note: BM은 TOEFL iBT 71(새 체계 4.0), IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 105, Cambridge 170이 기준이고, 2025년 9월 1일 이후 응시한 점수만 받아요. 영어 인터뷰도 보고, 기준보다 조금 낮으면(TOEFL 10점 이내 등) 영어 조건부로 합격할 수 있어요.

BM minimums: TOEFL iBT 71 (new scale 4.0), IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 105, Cambridge 170, from tests taken on/after Sept 1, 2025. Applicants also take an oral English interview, and those slightly below (e.g. within 10 TOEFL points) may be admitted on English probation.
aid: 국제학생도 원서·오디션만으로 실력 장학금(merit) 심사를 자동으로 받고, 학생의 99%가 장학금을 받아요(평균 학비의 60%). 국제학생은 2월 15일까지 CSS Profile(코드 4744)을 내야 해요.

International students are automatically considered for merit scholarships through the application and audition; 99% of students receive merit awards averaging 60% of tuition. Internationals must file the CSS Profile (code 4744) by Feb 15.
known: 샌프란시스코 도심에 있는 학생 약 450명의 음악원으로, 약 40%가 해외 출신이고 Roots, Jazz, and American Music(RJAM)·Technology and Applied Composition(TAC) 과정도 있어요.

A downtown San Francisco conservatory of about 450 collegiate students, roughly 40% international, with programs including Roots, Jazz, and American Music (RJAM) and Technology and Applied Composition (TAC).

schools.platform: CIM online application
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 tuition only; CIM's 2026-27 on-campus COA is $81,242 without insurance and $86,391 with the required CWRU medical plan.
audition_note: cello·violin·viola·piano·voice·composition·guitar·flute 등은 12월 1일까지 프리스크린 영상을 내고, 나머지 전공은 오디션 곡 30분 이상을 올려요. 2027년 2월 7·14·21·28일 클리블랜드에서 대면 오디션과 면접을 보고, 공식 페이지에 중국 난징(IME)에서 보는 오디션 안내도 있어요.

Cello, violin, viola, piano, voice, composition, guitar, flute and other listed areas submit a prescreening video by Dec 1; other areas upload at least 30 minutes of audition repertoire. In-person auditions and interviews are in Cleveland on Feb 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2027, and CIM also lists an audition option at IME (International Music Elites) in Nanjing, China.
english_note: 오디션을 잡으려면 12월 1일까지 TOEFL iBT 61, IELTS 6, Duolingo 100 이상이 필요하고, 조건 없는 합격은 3월 1일까지 TOEFL 79·IELTS 6.5가 필요해요(Duolingo는 TOEFL·IELTS·PTE 점수를 함께 내야 해요). TOEFL 61-78이면 여름 온라인 영어 과정을 들어야 해요.

To be scheduled for an audition, submit TOEFL iBT 61, IELTS 6 or Duolingo 100 by Dec 1; unconditional acceptance needs TOEFL 79 / IELTS 6.5 by Mar 1 (Duolingo must be backed by a TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score by Mar 1). Admits with TOEFL 61-78 must take CIM's summer virtual English program.
aid: CIM Scholarship은 오디션 평가가 핵심인 실력 기반(need-informed) 장학금으로, 매년 같은 금액으로 갱신돼요. 재정 필요 심사를 받으려면 CSS Profile을 내고, 거의 모든 학생이 장학금을 받아요.

The CIM Scholarship is merit-based and need-informed, driven mainly by faculty audition evaluations, and renews at the same amount each year. Need consideration requires the CSS Profile (or FAFSA); nearly all students receive scholarship support.
known: 클리블랜드 University Circle에 있는 클래식 전문 음악원으로, 재학생의 약 30%가 해외 출신이에요.
A classical-music conservatory in Cleveland's University Circle, with nearly 30 percent of students from outside the U.S.

schools.platform: Colburn Conservatory online application
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 net price for every student: tuition ($64,000) and housing/meals ($21,300) are fully covered by scholarships and grants; the remaining cost is the $4,850 comprehensive fee, books and other expenses.
audition_note: 모든 지원자가 12월 1일까지 프리스크린 영상을 내고, 12월 중하순에 LA 캠퍼스 대면 오디션 초대 여부를 알려줘요. 2027년 오디션은 악기별로 2월 1일~22일이고, piano만 1월 9-10일 온라인 1차 후 대면 최종 라운드를 봐요. 오케스트라 자리(빈 스튜디오)가 있는 악기만 뽑아요.

All applicants upload a prescreening video by Dec 1 and hear about in-person audition invitations in mid-to-late December. 2027 auditions on the Los Angeles campus run Feb 1-22 by instrument; piano has a virtual first round on Jan 9-10 before an in-person final. Only instruments with studio openings are accepted.
english_note: 영어 점수는 합격 여부에 영향을 주지 않지만, 비원어민은 TOEFL 새 체계 4.5(영역별 3.5) 또는 IELTS 6.0(영역별 5.5)을 1월 15일까지 내야 BM으로 들어가고, 아니면 Performance Diploma로 시작해요. 영어 학교에서 중학교 2년+고교 4년을 다녔으면 면제를 신청할 수 있어요.

English scores no longer affect admission, but non-native speakers need TOEFL new-scale 4.5 (no sub score below 3.5) or IELTS 6.0 (no sub score below 5.5) by Jan 15 to enter the BM; otherwise they start in the non-degree Performance Diploma. A waiver is possible after 2 years of English-medium middle school plus 4 years of English-medium high school.
aid: 국적과 상관없이 모든 합격생이 전액 학비 장학금과 기숙사·식비 지원금을 받아요. 남은 종합 수수료($4,850)도 재정지원을 신청해 줄일 수 있어요.

Every admitted student, regardless of nationality, receives a full-tuition scholarship plus grants covering on-campus housing and meals. Students may apply for aid to offset the $4,850 comprehensive fee.
known: LA 도심(Walt Disney Concert Hall 근처)에 있는 소규모 클래식 음악원으로, Colburn Orchestra 편성에 맞춰 학생을 뽑아요.
A small classical conservatory in downtown Los Angeles near Walt Disney Concert Hall that admits students according to the needs of the Colburn Orchestra and piano department.

schools.platform: Common App + Oberlin Conservatory Applicant Portal
schools.early_option: Early Decision (binding): Common App by Nov 1, screening materials by Nov 4, auditions Dec 4-5, decision by Dec 15.
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 tuition only; total with housing, meals and fees is $92,162 (plus books, personal costs, health insurance).
audition_note: 모든 분야가 먼저 스크리닝 영상을 내요(정시 12월 4일, ED 11월 4일). 최종 오디션은 주로 2월 주말 두 번에 걸쳐 캠퍼스에서 보고, 오기 어려우면 녹화 오디션을 2월 1일까지 낼 수 있어요(Music Theater 제외). Composition·TIMARA·Recording Arts는 오디션 대신 인터뷰를 봐요.

All areas submit screening materials first (Dec 4 for Regular Decision, Nov 4 for ED). Final auditions are mostly on campus over two February weekends; a recorded audition may be submitted by Feb 1 if travel isn't possible (not for Music Theater). Composition, TIMARA and Recording Arts & Production applicants interview instead of auditioning.
english_note: 비원어민은 TOEFL이나 IELTS를 내야 하고(시험이 없는 지역이면 Duolingo 가능), 최소 점수는 따로 없어요. 다만 점수가 낮으면 오디션 때 추가 영어 평가를 받을 수 있어요.

Non-native speakers must submit TOEFL or IELTS (Duolingo only if those are unavailable locally); there is no absolute minimum, but lower scorers may get an extra English assessment during the audition process.
aid: Oberlin은 국제학생을 포함해 합격생의 재정 필요를 100% 채워준다고 밝혀요. 재정지원 서류는 정시 1월 15일, ED 11월 1일까지 내요.
Oberlin states it meets 100 percent of demonstrated need for every admitted student, including international students. Aid materials are due Jan 15 (RD) or Nov 1 (ED).
known: 학생 거의 전부가 학부생인 음악원이 리버럴아츠 대학과 한 캠퍼스에 있고, 5년 안에 BM과 BA를 함께 받는 Double Degree 과정이 있어요.
An almost entirely undergraduate conservatory sharing a campus with a liberal arts college, with a Double Degree Program to earn both a BM and a BA in five years or fewer.

schools.platform: Berklee's own application (berklee.edu/apply; Common App not accepted)
schools.early_option: Early Action (nonbinding): apply by Nov 1, decision + scholarship by Jan 31.
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 degree tuition only (+$1,600 fees); Berklee's on-campus COA is $85,817 including room and board.
audition_note: BM은 프리스크린 없이 원서를 낸 뒤 실시간 오디션과 인터뷰를 봐요. 보스턴 캠퍼스, 온라인, 해외 지역 오디션 중에서 고를 수 있고 결과·장학금 심사는 똑같이 해요. 2026년 10월 27일~11월 2일 서울 현장 오디션이 공식 일정에 있어요.

BM applicants have no prescreen; after applying they do a live audition and interview in Boston, online, or at regional sites, all weighted equally for admission and scholarships. Official dates include in-person auditions in Seoul, South Korea, Oct 27-Nov 2, 2026.
english_note: BM 권장 최소 점수는 TOEFL iBT 72(새 체계 4), IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110, PTE 48이에요. IB Diploma를 받거나 고등학교 2년을 영어로만 공부했으면 면제될 수 있어요.
Recommended BM minimums: TOEFL iBT 72 (new scale 4), IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110, PTE 48. Waived for IB Diploma holders (not Bilingual) or after two years of high school taught entirely in English.
aid: 국제학생도 원서·오디션만으로 실력(merit) 장학금 심사를 자동으로 받아요. 신입 국제학생은 학교 need-based 지원 대상이 아니고, 2학기 이후 Thrive Scholarship을 원하면 CSS Profile(코드 3107)을 내요.

International students are automatically considered for merit scholarships through the application and audition. Entering international students are not considered for institutional need-based aid; for the Thrive Scholarship after the second semester they should file the CSS Profile (code 3107).
known: 보스턴에 있는 학부생 5,000명 이상의 현대음악 중심 학교로, 100개국 넘는 나라에서 학생이 오고 스페인 Valencia 캠퍼스도 있어요.
A Boston school focused on contemporary music with 5,000+ undergraduates from 100+ countries and a campus in Valencia, Spain.

schools.platform: Peabody's own online application (pre-screen uploaded there); JHU Common App additionally only for the Peabody/JHU Double Degree
schools.early_option: Early Decision (binding): application, fees, pre-screen, essay and English scores due Nov 1
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition only; direct billable costs on campus (tuition, fees, housing, food, health insurance) total $97,464
audition_note: 모든 연주 전공은 비디오 pre-screen을 원서와 함께 내야 해요(ED 11월 1일, RD 12월 1일). 본 오디션은 캠퍼스 대면이 원칙이고, 피아노·플루트·타악기·지휘 등은 녹화 오디션이 안 되며 그 외 전공은 녹화 오디션(RD 2월 1일 마감)을 낼 수 있어요.

All performance majors upload a video pre-screen with the application (ED Nov 1, RD Dec 1). Live on-campus auditions are strongly recommended; pianists, flutists, percussionists and conductors may not audition by recording, while other eligible applicants may submit a recorded audition (RD due Feb 1).
english_note: 영어 사용 학교에 2년 이상 재학했다면 성적표로 대체할 수 있어요. Duolingo는 받지 않아요.
Applicants enrolled 2+ years at an English-medium school may submit a transcript instead of a test score; Duolingo is not accepted.
aid: 국제학생도 오디션 때 자동으로 Peabody Merit Scholarship(Premier Talent, Full Tuition, Institutional) 심사를 받아요. 연방 지원은 받을 수 없고, 필요 기반 100% 지원 정책은 미국 국내 학생 대상이에요.

International students are automatically considered for Peabody Merit Scholarships (Premier Talent, Full Tuition, Institutional) at the audition; they are not eligible for federal aid, and the meet-full-need/no-loan policy applies to domestic undergraduates.
known: Johns Hopkins University 산하 음악원으로, 연주 교육과 함께 커리어·지역사회 활동을 엮은 Breakthrough Curriculum을 운영해요.
The conservatory of Johns Hopkins University, running a 'Breakthrough Curriculum' that pairs performance training with career and community engagement.

schools.platform: Eastman's own online application (Common App not used); dual-degree applicants also apply separately to the University of Rochester
schools.early_option: No ED/EA for Eastman (single Dec 1 deadline)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition only; international direct costs (tuition, housing, food, fees, health insurance) total $99,970, plus ~$2,522 estimated indirect
audition_note: 연주 지원자는 12월 1일까지 원서 안에 비디오 pre-screen을 올려야 해요. 통과하면 2027년 1월 29일~2월 26일 사이 금요일(전공별 날짜 다름)에 Rochester 캠퍼스에서 보거나, 원격(녹화 영상 2월 1일까지 또는 Zoom) 오디션을 선택할 수 있어요.

Performance applicants upload a video pre-screen in the application by Dec 1. Finalists audition on campus on set Fridays between Jan 29 and Feb 26, 2027 (dates vary by instrument), or choose the remote option (recorded final audition by Feb 1 or Zoom, depending on department).
english_note: 영어가 모국어가 아니면 시험 점수와 Non-Native English Essay를 12월 1일까지 내야 해요. 고등학교 입학 전 영어권 국가로 이주해 계속 산 경우만 면제돼요.

Non-native speakers submit a test score plus a Non-Native English Essay by Dec 1; only those who moved permanently to an English-speaking country before high school are exempt from the score (TOEFL iBT taken after Jan 21, 2026: band 4 minimum; older iBT: 83).
aid: 국제학생을 포함한 모든 합격생이 need-informed merit scholarship 심사를 받아요(거의 100%가 장학금 수령). 국제학생은 2월 28일까지 CSS Profile을 내면 필요 기반 추가 지원도 검토돼요.

All admitted undergraduates, domestic and international, are considered for renewable need-informed merit scholarships (nearly 100% receive one); internationals submit the CSS Profile by Feb 28 for need-based consideration. Admission is need-blind for ~90% of decisions and may be need-aware from the waitlist.
known: University of Rochester의 전문 음악대학으로, 국제학생이 학생의 약 25%(30개국)를 차지해요.
A professional school of the University of Rochester; international students make up about 25% of the student body, from 30 countries.

schools.platform: IU application or Common App + Jacobs School of Music (JSOM) Supplemental Application
schools.early_option: Early Action in some areas only (Guitar, Jazz excl. guitar/drums, Voice, Contemporary Dance, Music Business): IU + JSOM apps and pre-screen by Nov 1, in-person audition Nov 13, decision Jan 22, 2027
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 nonresident tuition + fees (tuition $41,181); total nonresident cost of attendance $65,465 incl. housing/food
audition_note: 많은 전공이 12월 1일까지 JSOM 지원서에 pre-screen을 올려야 해요(전공별로 달라요). 본 오디션은 Bloomington 캠퍼스 주말(2027년 1월 29-30일, 2월 5-6일, 2월 26-27일)에 보고, 못 오면 녹화 오디션을 2월 15일까지 낼 수 있어요(전공별 허용 여부 확인).

Many areas require a pre-screen uploaded to the JSOM Supplemental Application by Dec 1 (varies by area). Live auditions are on campus weekends (Jan 29-30, Feb 5-6, Feb 26-27, 2027); applicants who cannot attend may submit a final recorded audition by Feb 15, 2027 where the area allows it.
english_note: IU 학부 기준이에요(새 TOEFL은 3.5). 입학 후 수업 전에 기준(TOEFL 100 등)에 못 미치면 영어 지원 수업을 들을 수 있어요.

IU undergraduate admission minimums (new-format TOEFL: 3.5); SAT EBRW 560, ACT English 21, IB HL English A 4+ or AP English 3+ also accepted. Students below the class-start thresholds (e.g., TOEFL 100) may be placed in English support courses.
aid: 모든 지원자가 오디션·학업 성적으로 Jacobs merit scholarship(Dean's Scholarship 등)을 자동 심사받아요. 국제학생은 연방·주 필요 기반 지원을 받을 수 없어요.

All applicants are automatically considered for Jacobs merit scholarships (Dean's Scholarship, Premier Young Artist Award, Jacobs Scholar Award, etc.) based on audition and academics; international students are not eligible for federal or state need-based aid.
known: 70개 이상의 학위 과정, 7:1 학생-교수 비율, 30개 이상의 앙상블을 갖춘 대형 음악대학이에요.
A large music school with 70+ degree programs, a 7:1 student-to-faculty ratio and 30+ ensembles, with comparatively low tuition.

schools.platform: Common App (USC) + Thornton SlideRoom portfolio
schools.early_option: No ED/EA for Thornton majors (must select Regular Decision on Common App)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 undergraduate flat-rate tuition only; plus fees incl. $1,400 individual instruction and $3,777 health insurance; living costs not included
audition_note: 12월 1일까지 Common App과 SlideRoom 포트폴리오(비디오 pre-screen, 1-2분 자기소개 영상 포함)를 내야 해요. 12월 말에 결과가 오고, 초청되면 1월 말~2월 초에 캠퍼스에서 라이브 오디션을 봐요. 100마일 넘게 떨어져 있고 경제적 사정이 있으면 온라인 오디션을 요청할 수 있어요.

Submit the Common App plus the Thornton SlideRoom portfolio (unedited video pre-screen where required, plus a 1-2 minute intro video) by Dec 1. Pre-screen results come in late December; invited applicants audition live on campus, typically late January to early February. Applicants more than 100 miles away facing financial hardship may request an online audition (not guaranteed).
english_note: 영어 시험 면제는 없어요. Duolingo는 다른 시험을 볼 수 없을 때만 인정되고, 입학 후 ISE 시험을 따로 봐야 해요.

USC grants no waivers. TOEFL 100 (no section below 20) for tests before Jan 21, 2026, or 5 (each section 4+) after; IELTS 7; SAT EBRW 650 / ACT English 27 also accepted. Duolingo (130) only if no approved exam is available, and then the ISE exam is required on arrival.
aid: USC는 국제학생에게 필요 기반 지원을 주지 않아요. 12월 1일까지 지원을 마치면 USC Merit Scholarship 심사를 받고, Thornton 포트폴리오·오디션도 반영돼요.

USC offers no need-based aid to international applicants; all applicants complete by Dec 1 (including internationals) are considered for USC Merit Scholarships, which factor in the Thornton portfolio/audition plus academics, leadership and service.
known: Los Angeles에 있는 음악대학으로, 클래식뿐 아니라 Popular Music, Music Industry, Music Production 같은 현대 음악 전공도 학부에서 운영해요. 약 40개국 150명의 국제학생이 있어요.

A Los Angeles music school offering contemporary undergraduate majors (Popular Music, Music Industry, Music Production) alongside classical programs; about 150 international students from roughly 40 countries.

schools.program_name: Henry and Leigh Bienen School of Music
schools.platform: Common App or Apply Coalition with Scoir (Northwestern) + Bienen School Supplement
schools.early_option: Early Decision available: Bienen Supplement incl. pre-screen due Oct 15, NU application Nov 1, ED auditions by Nov 23, decision mid-December
schools.cost_note: Full-time undergraduate tuition (current year shown on NU aid site); total on-campus COA $99,375 incl. fees, housing and meals
audition_note: RD는 12월 1일까지 Bienen Supplement(해당 전공은 pre-screen 포함)를 내고, 2027년 2월 5-14일에 캠퍼스에서 오디션을 봐요. 오디션은 대면이 원칙이고 온라인 오디션은 사례별로만 검토해요. 작곡·BA 지원자는 오디션 없이 자료를 제출해요.

RD applicants submit the Bienen School Supplement (with pre-screen where required) by Dec 1 and audition on campus Feb 5-14, 2027 (ED: Supplement Oct 15, auditions in November). Auditions are expected on campus; virtual auditions are considered case by case. Composition and BA applicants submit materials without a performance audition.
english_note: 영어가 모국어가 아니거나 영어로 중등 교육을 받지 않았다면 TOEFL·IELTS·Duolingo 중 하나를 내야 하고, 최소 점수는 정해져 있지 않아요.
Required if English is not your first/primary language or your secondary schooling was not in English; TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo accepted, with no minimum score set.
aid: 국제학생도 merit scholarship 심사는 똑같이 받아요. Northwestern은 합격한 국제학생의 필요 기반 지원을 100% 충족하지만, 국제학생은 need-aware라 지원 신청이 합격에 영향을 줄 수 있어요.

International applicants go through the same merit scholarship process. Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted first-years (grant-only for internationals), but is need-aware for international applicants, so requesting aid can affect admission.
known: Northwestern 안의 음악대학으로, BM과 함께 BA·BS 과정, 그리고 다른 단과대(공학·저널리즘 등)와의 dual degree를 운영해요.
Northwestern's school of music, offering the BM alongside BA/BS degrees and dual-degree options with other Northwestern schools (e.g., engineering, journalism, communication).

schools.platform: Common App + Rice Writing Supplement (select Music as academic school) + Shepherd School Undergraduate Preliminary Submission (Rice's own online portal, $10 fee)
schools.early_option: No. Shepherd School admits by Regular Decision only (no ED I/ED II/QuestBridge).
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 Rice undergraduate COA, on campus (tuition $71,140 + fees $984 + living $20,530 + books $1,540 + personal $3,115); excludes health insurance and travel.
audition_note: 대부분 전공(현악·피아노·관악·타악·성악·작곡)은 12월 1일까지 영상 prescreening(Preliminary Submission)을 내고, 통과하면 겨울방학 전에 이메일로 오디션 초대를 받아요. 오디션은 휴스턴 캠퍼스에서 직접 봐야 하고, 지역 오디션은 없으며 녹음 오디션은 아주 특별한 사정이 있을 때만 담당자와 상의할 수 있어요.

Most areas (strings, piano, winds, brass, percussion, voice, composition) submit a video prescreen (Preliminary Submission) by December 1; faculty decide before winter break and email audition invitations. Auditions are live on the Houston campus only (no regional auditions); recorded auditions only in extreme circumstances by arrangement with admissions staff. Harp and organ submit an Audition Profile Form instead and are scheduled in early December.
english_note: 모국어와 수업 언어가 영어이거나, 고등학교·대학에서 2년 이상 전일제로 영어로 수업을 받았다면 TOEFL·IELTS·Duolingo를 내지 않아도 돼요.
Not required if your first language and language of instruction is English, or if you have had two years of full-time English-medium instruction at a high school or college.
aid: 국제학생 전용 장학금은 없지만, Shepherd School 실력 장학금(merit)은 국제학생도 똑같이 심사받아요. Rice는 국제학생에게 need-aware 방식으로 소수에게만 need-based 지원을 주고, 지원 때 신청하지 않으면 이후 학년에 신청할 수 없어요.

No special international scholarships, but Shepherd School merit awards (based on exceptional musical ability plus strong academics, renewable for four years) consider all applicants including internationals; the SSM Financial Assistance Application is required. Rice is need-aware for internationals and gives need-based aid to a limited number; you must request aid at the time of application.
known: 학생 약 285명(학부 약 120명)의 작은 음악대학으로, 오케스트라 두 개의 파트 수에 맞춰 신입생을 뽑고 모든 레슨을 교수진이 직접 해요.
A small school of about 285 students (about 120 undergraduates) that admits to fill specific ensemble and studio needs; all private lessons are taught by faculty, with a liberal-arts core at Rice.

schools.platform: Common App (with U-M supplement) + SMTD Artistic Profile ($45; one per program). SMTD does not review materials submitted on Acceptd.
schools.early_option: No ED/EA for SMTD. Optional October 15 early submission round for some programs (e.g., Musical Theatre, Dance) is not Early Action; dual-degree applicants may use EA only for the other U-M college.
schools.cost_note: 2025-26 U-M estimated budget for nonresident (out-of-state) lower-division students, based on LSA tuition ($63,962 tuition & fees + $16,246 housing/food + books/personal/transport); SMTD tuition may differ. 2026-27 figures not yet confirmed.
audition_note: 12월 1일까지 Common App과 Artistic Profile(대부분 연주 전공은 prescreening 영상 포함)을 내면, 서류·영상 심사를 통과한 학생만 오디션에 초대받아요. 오디션은 Ann Arbor 대면 또는 Zoom/녹화 형식이 전공별로 있고, 형식과 관계없이 똑같이 평가한다고 밝히고 있어요. 공식적으로 안내된 아시아 지역 오디션은 없어요.

Submit the Common App and Artistic Profile (with prescreening videos for most performance areas) by December 1; faculty invite selected applicants to audition on a rolling basis. Many areas offer in-person (Ann Arbor) or online/Zoom/recorded formats with full and equal consideration; Musical Theatre also holds Chicago auditions. No Asia regional auditions are listed. Decisions typically released in the first two weeks of March.
english_note: SMTD 학부는 TOEFL iBT 88-100(섹션 점수 기준 있음) 또는 IELTS 6.5가 필요하고 Duolingo는 받지 않아요. 해외 미국계 학교에서 최근 4년 이상 공부했고 SAT EBRW 650점 이상(또는 ACT Reading·English 각 27 이상)이면 영어 시험이 면제될 수 있어요.

SMTD undergraduates need TOEFL iBT 88-100 (sections 23+ listening/reading, 21+ speaking/writing) or IELTS 6.5, submitted by Dec 1 (unofficial score by Dec 14 at latest); Duolingo is not accepted. U-M may exempt students who recently completed 4+ years at an American or British school abroad with SAT EBRW 650+ or ACT Reading and English 27+.
aid: 국제학생도 12월 1일까지 지원하고 3월 1일 전에 오디션을 마치면 SMTD 실력 장학금(merit) 대상이 되고, 금액은 $2,000부터 전액 등록금까지예요. U-M 재정지원 사무실은 미국 시민권자·영주권자만 지원하기 때문에 국제학생은 need-based 지원을 기대하기 어려워요.

International students are eligible for SMTD merit-based scholarships ($2,000 up to full tuition) if they apply by Dec 1 and audition by Mar 1; SMTD encourages scholarship candidates to audition live in Ann Arbor when possible. The U-M Office of Financial Aid assists only U.S. citizens and permanent residents.
known: 대형 종합대학 안의 음악·연극·무용 전문 학교로, 학부생 약 850명에 40개가 넘는 학부 과정이 있고 학부생의 약 20%가 다른 단과대와 복수 학위(dual degree)를 해요.

A professional school of music, theatre and dance within a large research university, with about 850 undergraduates, 40+ undergraduate degree programs, a 5:1 student-faculty ratio, and about 20% of undergraduates in dual-degree programs with other U-M colleges.

schools.platform: Common App + Frost supplemental application (with prescreen video upload) in the UM applicant portal
schools.early_option: Early Action Nov 1 for music applicants (must audition on campus in December); ED I/ED II only for BS Audio Technology and BA Music Industry
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 total cost of attendance for international students (incl. health insurance); tuition $66,312 + fees $2,030
audition_note: BA Music Industry·BS Audio Technology를 뺀 대부분 전공은 프리스크린 영상이 필요하고, 통과하면 캠퍼스 오디션에 초대돼요. 대면 오디션을 강하게 선호하고 EA 지원자는 12월 캠퍼스 오디션이 필수지만, RD 클래식 지원자 대부분은 영상으로 오디션을 볼 수 있어요.

Most majors (except BA Music Industry and BS Audio Technology) require a prescreen video; those who pass are invited to audition on campus. Live auditions are strongly preferred and EA applicants must audition on campus in December, but most Regular Decision classical applicants may audition by video recording.
english_note: AP/IB HL English A·B 학점, 미국 고교 3년 이상 재학, SAT EBRW 650+ 또는 ACT 27+ 등으로 면제될 수 있어요.
Waivable with an A/B in AP or IB HL English, 3+ years at a U.S. high school, SAT 650+ or ACT 27+, among other conditions; listed scores are 'competitive' guidelines, not hard minimums.
aid: 모든 지원자는 국적과 관계없이 merit 장학금 자동 심사를 받고, Frost 전공자는 오디션 기반 음악 merit 장학금도 받을 수 있어요. 국제학생도 CSS Profile을 내면 need-based aid를 신청할 수 있지만, 국제학생 심사는 need-aware예요.

All applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships regardless of citizenship, and Frost applicants can receive audition-based music merit awards. Internationals may apply for need-based aid via the CSS Profile, but UM is need-aware for international applicants.
known: 50개 이상 학위 과정, 30개 이상 악기, 70개 이상 앙상블을 갖추고 즉흥·작곡·연주·프로덕션을 아우르는 교육을 강조해요.
Highlights 50+ degree programs, 30+ instruments and 70+ ensembles, with holistic training spanning improvisation, composition, performance and production.

schools.platform: Common App + CCM prescreen on Acceptd (GetAcceptd)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 non-resident Uptown tuition & fees $30,158 + CCM program fee $750/term ($1,500/yr); excludes housing, insurance. UC's international cost page lists total est. $50,830/yr (year not stated, general main campus)
audition_note: 모든 지원자가 12월 3일까지 Acceptd에 프리스크린을 올려야 하고, 통과자만 1~2월 오디션에 초대돼요. 캠퍼스 오디션 외에 New York·Chicago·LA Unifieds와 일부 전공 온라인 오디션이 있고, 국제학생(캐나다 제외)은 2월 1일까지 녹화 오디션을 낼 수 있어요(Collaborative Piano·Media Production 등 일부 제외).

All applicants must upload prescreen materials to Acceptd by Dec 3; only those who pass are invited to January-February auditions. Besides on-campus dates there are New York, Chicago and LA Unifieds and virtual auditions for select programs; international applicants (except Canadian residents) may submit recorded auditions by Feb 1 (not allowed for some programs such as Collaborative Piano and Media Production).
english_note: IELTS는 모든 영역 5.0, Duolingo는 모든 영역 80 이상이 필요하고, SAT EBRW 480 이상이나 미국 고교 1년 이상(영어 C 이상) 등으로 대체할 수 있어요.

IELTS also needs 5.0 on every band and Duolingo 80 on every subscore; SAT EBRW 480+, or one year of U.S. high school with a C or better in English, among other conditions, can satisfy the requirement.
aid: CCM 지원자는 프리스크린·오디션 실력으로 talent 장학금을 자동 심사받고, 12월 1일까지 지원을 마쳐야 장학금 대상이 돼요. UC는 학부 국제학생에게 need-based aid나 전액 장학금은 주지 않아요.

All CCM applicants are automatically considered for talent-based scholarships based on prescreen/audition, provided the application is complete by Dec 1. UC does not offer need-based aid or full-tuition scholarships to undergraduate international students; UC's International Outreach Award ($5,000-$15,000/yr) exists but CCM eligibility is not stated.
known: 음악뿐 아니라 Musical Theatre·Acting·Dance·Media Production까지 한 conservatory 안에서 가르치는 종합 공연예술 대학이에요.
A comprehensive performing-arts conservatory within a public research university, teaching music alongside musical theatre, acting, dance and media production.

schools.program_name: Carnegie Mellon School of Music (College of Fine Arts)
schools.platform: Common App + School of Music application on Acceptd
schools.early_option: No - the School of Music does not consider Early Decision applicants
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 first-year resident total cost of attendance (tuition $69,702)
audition_note: 연주 전공은 녹화 프리스크린, 작곡·Electronic Music·Music & Technology는 포트폴리오를 12월 1일까지 Acceptd에 내요. 1월 10~15일에 결과가 나오고, 오디션은 Pittsburgh 캠퍼스나 New York City에서 반드시 대면으로 봐야 해요(공식 페이지에 국제학생 녹화 오디션 예외는 없어요).

Performance applicants submit recorded prescreens and Composition/Electronic Music/Music & Technology applicants submit portfolios via Acceptd by Dec 1. Results come Jan 10-15, and all auditions must be live and in person in Pittsburgh or New York City (no recorded-audition exception for internationals is stated).
english_note: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 시험이 필수이고, 공식 페이지에 면제 조건은 따로 나와 있지 않아요(Duolingo는 4개 세부 점수도 모두 135 이상).
Required for all non-native English speakers; no waiver is listed (Duolingo also expects all four subscores at 135+, TOEFL subscores 25+ and IELTS subscores 7.5+ are considered).
aid: CMU는 학부 국제학생에게 원칙적으로 학교 자체 장학금·need-based aid를 주지 않아서, 전체 비용을 직접 부담할 계획이 필요해요. DACA 학생과 일부 특정 국가 학생만 예외예요.

CMU generally does not award institutional aid to undergraduate international students, so families should plan to pay the full cost; only DACA students and a small number of students from specific countries may be eligible for institutional funding.
known: 연구 중심 대학 안의 School of Music으로, 연주·작곡과 함께 Electronic Music, Music & Technology, BXA 같은 기술·학제 융합 과정을 둬요.
A School of Music inside a research university, offering performance and composition alongside Electronic Music, Music & Technology and interdisciplinary BXA programs.

schools.program_name: NYU Steinhardt — Department of Music and Performing Arts Professions
schools.platform: Common App to NYU Steinhardt + prescreen/audition or portfolio on GetAcceptd (Jazz prescreen via unlisted YouTube link by email)
schools.early_option: ED I (Nov 1) and ED II (Jan 1) available for music applicants; some programs (e.g. Jazz) exempt ED-admitted applicants from live auditions
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 Steinhardt estimated total cost of attendance (tuition & fees $68,576)
audition_note: BM 전공은 Acceptd로 프리스크린 영상이나 포트폴리오를 내고, 마감은 전공·지원 방식(ED I/ED II/RD)마다 달라요. 통과자는 뉴욕에서 대면 오디션을 보는데, 직접 오기 어려우면 영상 오디션도 받는 전공이 있어요. Music Business(BS)는 오디션이 없고 Music Technology는 포트폴리오로 심사해요.

BM applicants submit a prescreen video or portfolio via Acceptd; deadlines differ by program and plan (ED I/ED II/RD). Selected RD applicants are invited to live auditions in New York, and some programs (e.g. strings) accept video auditions from those who cannot attend. BS Music Business requires no audition; BM Music Technology is reviewed by artistic portfolio.
english_note: TOEFL은 2026년 1월 21일 이후 새 체계에서는 5 이상이 필요하고, 최근 3년간 영어로만 수업을 들었다면 면제될 수 있어요.

TOEFL iBT 100+ applies to tests taken on/before Jan 20, 2026; on the new scale (on/after Jan 21, 2026) the minimum is 5. Testing is required only if English is not your first language and in the last 3 years you took non-English coursework, ESL/ELL/IB English B, or a bilingual curriculum.
aid: NYU Promise에 따라 뉴욕 캠퍼스 신입생은 국제학생도 CSS Profile로 증명한 재정 필요액을 100% 장학금·grant로 지원받고, 가구 소득 10만 달러 미만이면 학비를 내지 않아요. NYU 자체 지원은 대부분 need-based예요.

Under the NYU Promise, first-year students on the New York campus, explicitly including international applicants, have 100% of demonstrated need (via CSS Profile) met with scholarships and grants, and families earning under $100,000 with typical assets pay no tuition. NYU institutional aid is predominantly need-based.
known: 뉴욕 한가운데 있는 대학 안에서 연주·작곡뿐 아니라 Music Technology, Music Business, Contemporary Production & Songwriting까지 폭넓은 음악 전공을 운영해요.
Offers a broad range of music degrees inside a New York City university, from performance and composition to Music Technology, Music Business and Contemporary Production & Songwriting.

schools.program_name: Clive Davis Institute of Recorded Music (Tisch School of the Arts)
schools.platform: Common App to NYU Tisch + creative portfolio on SlideRoom
schools.early_option: ED I (Nov 1) and ED II (Jan 1); portfolio due by the same deadline
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 Tisch estimated total cost of attendance (tuition & fees $75,326)
audition_note: 오디션은 없고, 지원 마감까지 SlideRoom에 creative portfolio(지원 동기, 창작 샘플, 영상 자기소개, 에세이, 플레이리스트, 이력서 등)를 내야 해요. 마감 후에는 포트폴리오를 받지 않아요.

No audition; applicants submit a SlideRoom creative portfolio (statement of intent, creative sample, written statement, video statement, personal essay, song playlist, resume) by the application deadline, and late portfolios are not accepted.
english_note: TOEFL은 2026년 1월 21일 이후 새 체계에서는 5 이상이 필요하고, 최근 3년간 영어로만 수업을 들었다면 면제될 수 있어요.

TOEFL iBT 100+ applies to tests taken on/before Jan 20, 2026; on the new scale (on/after Jan 21, 2026) the minimum is 5. Testing is required only if English is not your first language and in the last 3 years you took non-English coursework, ESL/ELL/IB English B, or a bilingual curriculum.
aid: NYU Promise에 따라 뉴욕 캠퍼스 신입생은 국제학생도 CSS Profile로 증명한 재정 필요액을 100% 장학금·grant로 지원받고, 가구 소득 10만 달러 미만이면 학비를 내지 않아요. NYU 자체 지원은 대부분 need-based예요.

Under the NYU Promise, first-year students on the New York campus, explicitly including international applicants, have 100% of demonstrated need (via CSS Profile) met with scholarships and grants, and families earning under $100,000 with typical assets pay no tuition. NYU institutional aid is predominantly need-based.
known: Tisch 안에서 녹음 음악(Recorded Music)을 중심으로 프로듀싱·아티스트 활동·음악 산업을 함께 배우는 BFA 과정이에요.
A BFA in Recorded Music within Tisch that combines creative production and artistry with the business of the music industry.

schools.program_name: Boston University College of Fine Arts — School of Music
schools.platform: Common App + Acceptd (audition scheduling, prescreen, recorded audition)
schools.early_option: ED 1 (Common App + audition scheduling by Nov 2, 2026; November auditions; no prescreen needed) and ED 2 (Jan 5, 2027)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 resident undergraduate total cost of attendance (tuition $73,024); no separate international figure
audition_note: 첼로·더블베이스·플루트·비올라·피아노·트롬본·트럼펫·바이올린·성악은 12월 1일까지 프리스크린 녹화가 필요해요(ED 1은 면제). RD 지원자 대부분은 대면 오디션 대신 Acceptd로 단판 영상 오디션을 낼 수 있고, 이 경우 프리스크린은 따로 안 내도 돼요.

Cello, double bass, flute, viola, piano, trombone, trumpet, violin and voice applicants must submit a prescreen recording by Dec 1 (ED 1 exempt). Most Regular Decision applicants may instead submit a single-round final video audition via Acceptd, in which case no separate prescreen is needed; live RD auditions run Jan 22-Feb 5, 2027.
english_note: TOEFL은 90~100점 이상(영역별 20점 이상), 새 체계는 5.0 이상이 기준이고, 면제는 입학처 재량으로 판단해요.
TOEFL iBT 90-100+ with 20+ in each section (new format from Jan 21, 2026: 5.0+); Duolingo 125-135 for competitive applicants; waivers are at the Board of Admissions' discretion.
aid: 국제학생은 BU의 need-based aid 대상이 아니에요. 대신 College of Fine Arts 장학금, Trustee·Presidential Scholarship 같은 merit 장학금 심사를 받을 수 있고, 학업 merit 장학금은 12월 1일까지 지원해야 해요.

International students are not eligible for BU need-based aid, but may be considered for merit awards including College of Fine Arts scholarships and the Trustee and Presidential Scholarships; academic merit consideration requires applying by Dec 1.
known: 150여 년 전 음악을 학위 과정으로 처음 정착시킨 학교라고 소개하며, 연구 대학 안에서 연주자·교육자·학자를 함께 길러요. BU Tanglewood Institute를 운영해요.

Describes itself as the first U.S. school to center music study as a degree over 150 years ago, training performers, educators and scholars within a research university; runs the BU Tanglewood Institute.

schools.program_name: UCLA Herb Alpert School of Music
schools.platform: UC Application (music major as first choice) + supplemental application on Acceptd
schools.early_option: No early round (UC has no ED/EA)
schools.cost_note: 2026-27 nonresident undergraduate estimated total cost (on campus), incl. nonresident supplemental tuition $39,270 and university fees $16,430
audition_note: UC 원서(11월 30일) 뒤에 Acceptd 보충 지원서를 12월 4일까지 내야 하고, Music Performance·Music Education은 대부분 악기(바순·기타·하프·오보에·오르간·타악기 제외), Global Jazz Studies는 모든 악기에서 프리스크린 영상이 필요해요. 12월 말에 통과 여부를 알려주고 1월 말 캠퍼스 오디션·인터뷰를 보는데, 오기 어려우면 최종 녹화로 대신할 수 있어요.

After the UC Application (Nov 30), applicants submit the Acceptd supplemental by Dec 4; prescreen videos are required for Music Performance and Music Education (all instruments except bassoon, guitar, harp, oboe, organ, percussion) and for all Global Jazz Studies instruments. Advancing applicants are notified in late December for late-January on-campus auditions/interviews, and those unable to come may submit final recordings.
english_note: 영어로 수업받은 기간이 3년 미만이면 필요하고, 표기 점수는 '경쟁력 있는' 기준이에요(새 TOEFL 체계는 5 이상). 고교 전 과정을 영어로 이수했으면 면제돼요.

Required if you had under 3 years of English-medium instruction; scores listed are 'competitive' (new TOEFL scale: 5+ with 5+ subscores; old scale 100+ with subscores above 24). Waived if all secondary schooling was in English.
aid: UCLA는 미국 시민권자·영주권자가 아닌 학부생에게 장학금이나 재정 지원을 주지 않아요. 비자를 위해 약 8만 달러 이상의 자금 증명이 필요해요.

UCLA does not award scholarships or financial aid to undergraduates who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents; international students must show roughly $80,739+ in funds (Fall 2026 figure) for the visa.
known: 공립 연구 대학 안의 음악 대학으로, Music Performance(BM)와 함께 Ethnomusicology·Musicology·Global Jazz Studies·Music Industry 등 BA 전공을 운영해요.

A music school within a public research university, offering the BM in Music Performance alongside BA majors in Ethnomusicology, Musicology, Global Jazz Studies, Music Industry, Composition and Music Education.
